prompts.open:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished opaque square game texture, a tactical naval battle board background seen from a TRUE VERTICAL ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN CAMERA, looking directly down onto the water. Generate 2048 by 2048 pixels, square.
Primary request: premium finely painted maritime strategy game water artwork. This image will sit behind small wooden ship tokens, thin grid lines and targeting markers, so keep it visually quiet and legible. Paint fine organic ripples at a small consistent scale, with restrained non-repeating natural water detail and very low local contrast. Soft diffuse daylight, no concentrated sun glints. The whole canvas is a continuous overhead water plane, sharp but delicate surface detail, subtle depth variation, no perspective scaling. Keep the middle 80 percent free of solid features and strong highlights; no central focal point, no radial composition, no vignette. Match a mature hand-painted pirate game: restrained desaturated deep teal and blue, realistic water rather than a cartoon or photograph. Make edge patterns suitable for continuous world texture; avoid obvious corner motifs or visible seams.
Constraints: NO horizon, NO sky, NO ships, NO wakes, NO characters, NO text, NO grid, NO UI, NO symbols, NO border, NO numbers, NO tropical island picture, NO coast silhouettes entering the playable center, NO tall breaking waves, NO white noise. Fully opaque.
Environment: OPEN OCEAN. Uniform tranquil deep petrol-blue sea with a hint of teal. Small low rolling wavelets read as delicate smooth tonal strokes from overhead. Very sparse soft pale cyan foam flecks, never bright white, under 1 percent of the image. No land, reefs, submerged rocks, or vegetation. Subtle irregular deep-water tonal patches only, not bands or a gradient.
